\documentclass{article}
% The cases of test-boxcenter, with center renewed in the preamble through
% a copy of LaTeX's, as documents do to change its font. The copy comes
% after a robust command and inside the braces of \@firstofone's argument,
% which change nothing in the PDF.
\let\oldcenter\center \let\endoldcenter\endcenter
\makeatletter
\renewenvironment{center}{\setlength{\topsep}{\topsep}\@firstofone{\oldcenter}}{\endoldcenter}
\makeatother
\input{test-boxcenter-cases.ltx}
